name: Greenoaks Capital
rationale: Co-led AIR's $50M seed alongside Sequoia (led the $40M second tranche vs Sequoia's $10M). Repeatedly shows up as a growth-stage co-investor in the same AI deals as watchlist VCs this quarter (also referenced with Sequoia on the Empirik/AIR cluster of September announcements).

name: Radical Ventures
rationale: Co-led (with Khosla Ventures) the Discovery Loop seed -- Jeff Dean/Sanjay Ghemawat/Quoc Le/Oriol Vinyals' new AI-for-science startup, also backed by Alphabet. Toronto-based AI-focused VC; worth tracking given repeat co-investment alongside key watchlist names in frontier-adjacent deals.

name: Accel
rationale: New co-lead (with a16z) of Cognition's $2B+ Series E at a $48B valuation -- a top-tier generalist VC not currently on the watchlist that is now leading alongside a16z in one of the quarter's largest AI application rounds.
